title: At Adobe Max, Adobe unveils Creative Cloud and Firefly AI updates to make designing and editing easier, including Premiere's new Generative Remove tool (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: At Adobe Max, Adobe unveils Creative Cloud and Firefly AI updates to make designing and editing easier, including Premiere's new Generative Remove tool — Here are the new editing and design tools coming to Creative Cloud apps and Adobe's Firefly suite.
